hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'gh pr create' && echo "$CMD" | grep -qE -- '--base[[:space:]]+main|--base=main'; then echo '{"decision": "block", "reason": "PRs must target dev, not main.", "hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "permissionDecision": "deny", "permissionDecisionReason": "PRs must target dev, not main. Use --base dev instead. Only merge to main when changes are stable and reviewed."}}'; fi
